scope.description: Local documented AppendFuture method ordering in actual in-memory pipeline consumption.
assumptions: Observation wrappers faithfully delegate the same future
Only the first actual Response invocation is selected independently of observed ordering
excluded: Invalid response data or commit index
Other future implementations and fault schedules

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Observation-only future wrappers record Error return and Response entry; delegate all protocol data unchanged.
A forwarding Consumer goroutine preserves per-pipeline order; finite scheduling may change but no producer or reply is fabricated.
Select one first observed call independent of its result to avoid conflating operation identities.
boundaries: Invalid response data or commit index
Other future implementations and fault schedules
No malformed result or invalid consensus support is checked.
The observation is method discipline on this concrete producer/consumer integration, not overall pipeline correctness.
No custom transport malfunction or incorrect commit index is inferred.
Only the first observed call is checked; other operations are outside this bounded monitor.
